notes.title: On October 1, 2024,“The charge is the fire”v0.2.0 was officially released
notes.notes:
After my unremitting efforts, “The charge is the fire” finally ushered in its first major update. This update includes:
1. Improved and added character models and actions.
2. Optimized and added sound effects to the game. 
3. Increased the plot. 
4. Re-set the customs clearance conditions. 
5. Added a feedback system for the character after different parts of the body are injured.
6. Added real bullet trajectory. 
7. A more realistic battlefield atmosphere. 
8. Rewrote the game code to improve the operation efficiency.
9.New user interface.
Congratulations! Now you can finally kill devils to your heart's content. Good luck!
